inputs.modified_text: That massive anti-Trump "No Kings" rally was going along until the streets packed up and federal officers suddenly moved in with tear gas and arrests, flipping the whole thing into chaos. They claim agitators squared off with authorities after police ordered everyone to disperse, but don't buy the official line for a second. This is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to provoke the situation, manufacture disorder, and then pin it on the protesters so they can justify more crackdowns and control the narrative.
